descriptor.label: Zambia NSDI ZILMIS Lots — bounded Chingola review

evidence: Frozen city-1183-chingola.json registryBasis and coverageAssessment identify the official Zambia NSDI CadasterNew Lots layer as lots from ZILMIS, a cadastral/registry source; https://www.map.gov.zm/arcgis/rest/services/NSDI_Vector/CadasterNew/MapServer.

The frozen packet records Chingola City Council estate management processing land applications and maintaining the deeds register (https://www.chingolacouncil.gov.zm/?page_id=770) and plot allocation/town planning and land distribution (https://www.chingolacouncil.gov.zm/?page_id=792).

Frozen chingola-sample.geojson SHA256 92598b1c05412cc6826bdf57f6aadb6e56d93d0e22475c56f0378f9b58780481 contains complete native OBJECTID polygons 109239, 109240 and 109241 from a bounded 10 km envelope near Chingola's WUP point. This confirms bounded city-area geometry, not municipal or citywide completeness; the exact WUP point returned zero features.

Attempt-02 official-inspection.json confirms anonymous layer metadata: esriGeometryPolygon, native SDE.Lots.OBJECTID OID, EPSG:32735, GeoJSON queries and supportsPagination:false. Existing production object-ids queries verify counts/manifests and full native polygons without offset pagination.
